title: Show Your Arms
description: Show Your Arms is a simple datapack that makes armor stands have arms.
body:
Show Your Arms is a simple datapack that makes armor stands have arms, like the ones in bedrock edition. the way it works is very simple. every tick, it executes as every armor stand that doesn't have arms (ShowArms:0b in the data) and gives it arms (ShowArms:1b in the data).
it is lag free and super easy to use. as any armor stand will just... have arms!
